claims.hypothesis: Can [C II] detect the parent gas clouds of UV clumps at z~3.4?

claims.result: Three [C II] clumps (NE, SW, tentative C) detected, unresolved at ~300-400 pc
claims.finding: [C II] is a promising tracer of molecular clouds at high redshift

evidence.quote: We conducted ALMA observations probing scales down to $\sim 300$ pc and detected three [C II] clumps.

why_this_data.value: Lensing plus [C II] avoids dust extinction and gives resolution to probe clump gas
